data.body:
Janitor Phase 2 Verification completed on fixed snapshot `9a94ef9737fbdf070ae314bba6e797319aee2301`.

Fresh blue-team verifiers independently processed all 78 deduplicated candidates against code, full call sites, history/ADRs, concrete escape states, and the current known-fine registry. Fixed floors produced 47 survivors (29 critical, 18 major; 46 reachable defects and one maintenance-hardening item) and 31 explicit drops/merges: INTENTIONAL 12, MISREAD 10, IMMATERIAL 4, TOO_VAGUE 3, SUPERSEDED 2. No candidate matched known-fine and no citation received the hard bad-citation veto.

The durable scored record is `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md`; reusable audit patterns and the pre-edit DO_NOT_MOVE ledger were appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md`. `git diff --check` passes. No production code, tests, config, or docs outside the janitor artifact tree were changed.

Phase 3 has started with two blind asymmetric proposers: one uses current code + live OSS/community evidence, the other current code + this project's ADR/ticket/history record. Remediation and ticketization remain pending.
